backend/main.mo: IC canister managing user profiles and publisher records with access control, permission checks, and CRUD operations for publishers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping new note category updates to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend files, covering configuration, layout, hooks, and UI components.
frontend/.env: Sets the Internet Identity provider URL for authentication.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and theme variables for light/dark mode styling across the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint that loads the React application into the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures application routing and authentication handling, rendering either the login screen or the main layout.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Condu: Modal form for creating or editing trained conductors, loading publishers and submitting create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Delet: Confirmation dialog that deletes a conductor record via mutation with pending-state UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Att: Displays publisher attendance statistics with percentages and progress bars, or a no-data message.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Del: Confirmation dialog that deletes a meeting attendance record using a mutation hook.
Confirmation dialog for deleting a group visit, showing success or error toasts.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Gro: Card UI showing group visit details, attendee names, notes, and edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Rec: Modal form to create or edit meeting attendance, including date, type, and publisher selection.
Modal form to create or edit a group visit with date, topics, attendees, notes, and optional next visit date.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout containing sidebar, header, routed content, and toast managers.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header bar with menu toggle, app title, and logout action clearing identity and cache.
frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.t: Responsive sidebar showing themed navigation links with active and hover styling. Supports mobile overlay, route-aware highlighting, and interactive hover color effects.
frontend/src/components/notes/AddGlobalN: Modal for creating or editing global notes with category selection, publisher attachment, validation, and toast feedback. Handles form initialization, submission, and state reset.
frontend/src/components/notes/GlobalNote: Card displaying a note’s title, category, preview text, date, and edit/delete actions. Supports category-based coloring and optional attached publisher info.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/AddPion: Modal for adding monthly pioneer hours with validation and async mutation. Clears form on close and shows loading state during submission.
Modal for creating a pioneer by selecting an active publisher and service year. Validates input, triggers creation, shows toast feedback, and resets form.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Current: Badge showing pioneer progress based on average monthly hours, with states for loading, no entries, on track, or behind.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/DeleteP: Confirmation dialog for deleting a pioneer record with async handling and success/error toasts. Invokes optional callback after deletion.
Dialog confirming deletion of a specific month’s pioneer hours, displaying details and showing pending/loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/EditPio: Modal for editing a pioneer's monthly hours and submitting updates via mutation.
Modal for editing pioneer records, selecting a publisher and service year, and saving via update mutation.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Pioneer: Card displaying total hours, average hours, and status badge for a pioneer.
Table row showing a pioneer's service year stats with edit/delete actions and status badge.
frontend/src/components/publicWitnessing: Confirmation dialog to delete a trained publisher using a delete mutation.
Modal for creating or editing trained publisher records, including date, authorization, and publisher selection.
frontend/src/components/publishers/AddPu: Modal for adding a new publisher with form fields, validation, and submit mutation.
frontend/src/components/publishers/Delet: Empty or placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/publishers/EditP: Modal for editing a publisher’s details, initializing form fields from the selected publisher and submitting updates via mutation.
Empty file placeholder for a modal to edit publisher notes.
frontend/src/components/publishers/Publi: Empty file placeholder for a card displaying a publisher note.
Empty file placeholder for a notes section related to a publisher.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Edit: Modal for editing shepherding visit data, with form validation and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Reco: Modal for creating new shepherding visits, handling form validation and API creation.
frontend/src/components/system/Reconnect: Component that shows or hides a reconnecting toast based on network and actor state.
frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskMod: Modal for creating tasks with validation, timestamp conversion, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskMo: Modal for editing existing tasks, preloading values and submitting updates through a mutation.
frontend/src/components/territories/AddT: Modal form for creating a new territory with validation and submission via useCreateTerritory.
frontend/src/components/territories/Chec: Table component that displays sorted checkout history with optional edit and delete actions.
Modal for checking out a territory by selecting a publisher, date, and campaign flag, then submitting via useCheckOutTerritory.
frontend/src/components/territories/Dele: Confirmation dialog for deleting a checkout record using useDeleteCheckoutRecord.
Confirmation dialog to delete a territory note through useDeleteTerritoryNote.
frontend/src/components/territories/Edit: Modal for editing an existing checkout record, including publisher, dates, and campaign status, submitted via useUpdateCheckoutRecord.
Modal for editing territory number and type with validation and update via useUpdateTerritory.
Modal for editing a territory note, handling content state and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/territories/Terr: Card displaying a territory note with edit and delete action buttons.
Section for creating, listing, editing, and deleting territory notes with sorting and modals.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedPr: Button component that applies a theme color with automatic contrast calculation.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedTa: Themed table header row and header cell components using background color with contrast text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddMeetingAttendan: Mutation for submitting meeting attendance records and refreshing related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddPublisher.ts: Mutation for creating a publisher, including privilege mapping and cache invalidation.
Hooks for fetching and updating the caller's user profile tied to the actor state.
Mutation for checking out a territory and invalidating related territory queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGlobalNote.t: Mutation for creating global notes with validation and cache refresh for global notes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGroupVisit.t: Mutation for adding group visit records and invalidating group visit caches.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePioneer.ts: Mutation for creating a pioneer and refreshing the pioneers list.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateShepherdingV: Mutation for creating shepherding visits and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTask.ts: Mutation for creating tasks and invalidating all task queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTerritory.ts: Mutation for creating a territory with generated ID and refreshing territory lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedCondu: Creates a trained conductor via mutation and invalidates the trainedConductors query with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedPubli: Creates a trained publisher, optionally updates S-148 status, and invalidates trainedPublishers with notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCheckoutReco: Deletes a checkout record and invalidates both the specific territory and territories list queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGlobalNote.t: Deletes a global note and invalidates the globalNotes query.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGroupVisit.t: Deletes a group visit and invalidates related groupVisits queries while removing the specific visit cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteMeetingAtten: Deletes a meeting attendance record, invalidates meetingAttendance queries, and displays toast messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePioneer.ts: Deletes a pioneer and invalidates the pioneers list while removing the single pioneer cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePublisher.ts: Deletes a publisher with optimistic updates and error rollback, then refetches the publishers list.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTask.ts: Deletes a task and invalidates the tasks query.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedCondu: Deletes a trained conductor, invalidates trainedConductors, and shows success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedPubli: Deletes a trained publisher, invalidates trainedPublishers, and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalNotes.ts: Provides queries for all global notes and for fetching a single global note by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisit.ts: Fetches a single group visit by ID with query enablement checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisits.ts: Fetches group visits for a given group ID with validation and conditional query enabling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity context with login, logout, state management, and AuthClient initialization.
Fetches meeting attendance records, optionally filtered by group number.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneerHours.ts: Manages pioneer hours with queries for records and mutations for add, update, and delete operations.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneers.ts: Provides queries to fetch all pioneers or a single pioneer by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneersOnTrack.ts: Calculates how many pioneers meet average-hour requirements for a service year.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides queries to fetch all publishers or a single publisher by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceMeetingCond: Provides a query hook to load all service meeting conductor assignments using the actor service.
frontend/src/hooks/useShepherdingVisit.t: Contains hooks to fetch, update, update notes, and delete individual shepherding visits with cache invalidation.
Provides a query hook to fetch all shepherding visits from the actor backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: Exposes hooks to fetch tasks by status and to load a single task by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritories.ts: Provides a query hook to load all territories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritory.ts: Includes hooks to fetch, update, delete, and change availability of a single territory with related cache updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritoryNotes.ts: Defines hooks to fetch, create, update, and delete notes associated with a specific territory.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrainedConductor.t: Contains hooks to fetch a trained conductor, update notes, and delete a conductor with appropriate cache invalidation.
Provides a hook to fetch all trained service meeting conductors.
Offers a query hook to load all trained publishers.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCheckoutReco: Defines a mutation hook to update a territory checkout record with timestamp normalization and cache refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGlobalNote.t: Provides a mutation hook for updating a global note and invalidating the global notes list.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGroupVisit.t: Implements a mutation to update a group visit and invalidate related group visit queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateMeetingAtten: Adds a mutation to update meeting attendance, converting dates and refreshing queries with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePioneer.ts: Defines a mutation to update a pioneer profile and invalidate related pioneer queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePublisher.ts: Provides a mutation to update publisher details including privilege mapping and refresh publisher lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTask.ts: Contains a mutation to update a task and invalidate all task queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTaskCompleti: Implements a mutation to toggle task completion status and refresh task data.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedCondu: Defines a mutation hook to update a trained conductor, invalidate related queries, and show a success toast.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedPubli: Provides a mutation hook to update a trained publisher and S-148 status, with query invalidation and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and extensive color variables including custom theme utilities for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers, loading global styles.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx: Simple placeholder page showing a construction icon and message for unfinished features.
frontend/src/pages/ConductorProfile.tsx: Displays and manages a trained conductor’s profile, allowing note editing, deletion, and opening an edit modal.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Loads various datasets to compute and display congregation statistics such as tasks, attendance, notes, and territory status.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroupProf: Shows details for a field service group including publishers, visits, attendance, and modals for recording or editing entries.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroups.ts: Lists all field service groups with overseer/assistant info and active publishers, linking to each group's profile.
frontend/src/pages/GroupVisitProfile.tsx: Displays details for a specific group visit, loads publishers, validates group, and provides edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Shows login screen and triggers Internet Identity authentication with a styled button.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Manages global notes with category filtering, add/edit/delete modals, and sorted note lists.
frontend/src/pages/PioneerProfile.tsx: Shows a pioneer's details and monthly hours with inline editing, add/delete modals, and summary stats.
frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx: Lists all pioneers with add/edit/delete actions, CSV export, and navigation to individual profiles.
frontend/src/pages/PublicWitnessing.tsx: Displays trained publishers for public witnessing with sorting and add/edit/delete management.
frontend/src/pages/PublisherProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile for a single publisher with edit and delete actions, loading states, and privilege badges.
frontend/src/pages/Publishers.tsx: Lists all publishers with filtering, sorting, and actions for adding, editing, and deleting records.
frontend/src/pages/ServiceMeetingConduct: Shows trained conductors in a sortable list with add, edit, delete, and navigation to conductor profiles.
frontend/src/pages/Shepherding.tsx: Manages shepherding visits with search, sorting, record/edit modals, and delete confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/ShepherdingVisitProfi: Displays details for a single shepherding visit with note editing, edit modal, and delete workflow.
frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx: Tasks page with filtering, CRUD actions, CSV export, and themed UI for managing tasks.
frontend/src/pages/Territories.tsx: Territories list page with sorting, CRUD actions, CSV export, and themed table view.
frontend/src/pages/TerritoryProfile.tsx: Detailed territory profile page supporting edits, checkout management, history, and deletion.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfile.tsx: User profile page with editable name and congregation fields and save/cancel handling.
frontend/src/theme/colorUtils.ts: Utility functions for hex color parsing, luminance calculation, contrast selection, and lightening.
frontend/src/theme/pageTheme.ts: Defines page theme colors and helpers to resolve theme colors based on route paths.
frontend/src/utils/fieldServiceGroupColo: Maps field service groups to specific colors with a helper for lookup.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Date formatting utilities converting various backend timestamp formats to readable strings.
frontend/src/utils/groupVisitNotes.ts: Parses a combined notes string into structured fields for discussion topics, overseer notes, assistant notes, and next visit date.
frontend/src/utils/meetingAttendanceStat: Provides functions to compute active publisher counts, meeting attendance averages and percentages, and overall attendance stats.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersCsvExport.ts: Generates CSV data for pioneers, including headers, month ordering, field escaping, and browser download support.
frontend/src/utils/privilegeBadges.ts: Returns Tailwind class names for privilege badges based on role.
frontend/src/utils/reconnectState.ts: Tracks and broadcasts reconnect error state with subscription support.
frontend/src/utils/serviceYear.ts: Calculates the current service year string based on today's date.
frontend/src/utils/tasksCsvExport.ts: Builds CSV data for tasks with headers and date formatting plus a browser download helper.
frontend/src/utils/territoryAssignmentRe: Creates S-13-E territory assignment CSVs, formatting dates and extracting recent checkout records.
frontend/src/utils/territoryTime.ts: Normalizes timestamps and calculates checkout durations in days or months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL and session-stored parameters, providing retrieval, persistence, and cleanup utilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended color palette, custom animations, and several plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state for adding four new note categories across UI tabs and modal dropdowns, including existing features and a pending request.
